scope: On the Becoming core's law of judging a listed family through a reduction: in WisdomFallibleJudgment the admitted realizations of listed event laws are a listed family, the endpoint a mode reaches is a reduction of a realization and the one-third risk bound of its law is an observable; the periphery's judge statement is the core's Judges on that family (judges_iff). So a judge of the endpoint classifies the certificate for every admitted realization exactly where realizations reaching one endpoint carry one certificate (endpoint_judge_iff, from Readout.judges_iff_lumpedOn), and since mode 1 of the uniform and of the biased law reach one endpoint while the bound holds of the first and fails of the second, no_endpoint_only_prior_certificate follows from Readout.no_judge_of_merged (no_endpoint_only_prior_certificate_by_core). The supplied laws, equal weights and the bound keep the earlier modules' scope; the bound is a numerical specification, not an ethical permission.
